step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram features a virtual events system built on AWS. An incoming trigger leads to a front-end Lambda function that interacts with Amazon Chime. Chime handles real-time audio/video and emits events to a top SQS queue, which persists analytics into an S3 bucket. Chime also updates session state in a middle DynamoDB table. For recording workflows, Chime sends messages to a bottom SQS queue, triggering a second Lambda function that launches Fargate containers to encode video. Additional DynamoDB and S3 instances store container metadata and recorded video files.
